invariants: Canon paths stay bit-identical: every new behavior is flag-gated, default OFF; parity vs canon proven before a task ships
trading_data.db (24GB) is the read-only source of record — never write to it, never DDL it; all verification runs against fixtures/trading_fixture.db (regenerate: fixtures/make_fixture.py)
Leak-free evaluation: no feature/label may read data beyond time t; performance claims are cost-honest (fees+slippage), per-decision H-strided Sharpe, and need >=3 seeds before any promotion claim
Never pre-generate training data to disk; no disk I/O inside training loops — memory hierarchy is VRAM > RAM > disk
GPU jobs are never launched bare: XLA_PYTHON_CLIENT_MEM_FRACTION=0.7, cgroup RAM cap (single job <=18G), at most ONE GPU job on the workstation
Never send live exchange orders, never read/print API keys or secrets; live-trading code paths run dry-run only without the operator in the loop
Expensive real-data validation (multi-hour training, full-timeline evals) is SCHEDULED (server/overnight one-shots), never polled inside the factory loop
JAX discipline: no lax.cond inside vmap (use jnp.where), guard divisions with jnp.maximum(x, 1e-10), static shapes in lax.scan, block_until_ready before device-to-host

models._comment: Operator instruction 2026-07-31: run all subagents as sonnet, escalate to opus if implementation fails. The orchestrator reads this at startup (skill step 1) and passes it as the Agent tool's `model` parameter. NOT harness-enforced: the four ~/.claude/plugins/cache/apothecary/dark-factory/0.2.0/agents/dark-factory-*.md declare no `model:` frontmatter, so absent this they silently inherit the session model. Kept here rather than in the plugin because the plugin is shared across projects and is clobbered on marketplace update.
models.escalation_policy: Spawn every subagent on `default`. Re-spawn the SAME unit of work on `escalate_to` when a sonnet attempt fails: the implementer reports it could not complete the task, it errors out or dies, it returns work that does not compile or whose suites are red, or a verification round finds a BLOCKER the sonnet implementer then fails to close. Escalation is per unit of work and does not persist — the next task starts on `default` again. `halt_after_failures` still counts total fix->verify cycles across BOTH tiers, so escalation buys a better attempt, not extra attempts.

always._comment: Roles pinned to a tier regardless of `default`. Empty = every role follows `default`. Add e.g. "judge:fail-closed": "opus" if a lens proves too weak on sonnet — run 23's fresh fail-closed judge found 4 MAJOR that three prior lenses missed, so that lens is the first candidate if sonnet under-performs.
